message:
feat(tactics): close constructor contradictions with compact literal proofs

Search local empty evidence, negations and nested constructor equalities
using ordinary recursors and equality transports. Use admitted Nat.beq
for huge literal disequalities without unary successor expansion. Pin
memoized endpoint allocations and retain scope and checking obligations.

Seven additional source tests and a real installed CLI test pass locally,
including 129-bit literals, proof-family refusals and injection followed
by dependent subst. Scoped Clippy and workspace compilation pass. Remote
publication reruns all five packages before committing production code.
